route_note: Buses from Mien Tay station run directly to My Tho in about 1.5-2 hours; many visitors join a Mekong Delta tour that includes the boat leg from My Tho's waterfront.

route_note: Local bus 13 or tour minibuses run from central Saigon to Cu Chi town in roughly 1.5-2 hours, then a short taxi or shuttle reaches the tunnels site.
see: Ben Duoc temple and tunnel section

tour_query: Cu Chi Tunnels day trip from Ho Chi Minh City

route_note: Fast ferries from Bach Dang pier reach Vung Tau in about 1.5 hours, or express buses take 2-2.5 hours via the highway.
tour_query: Vung Tau day trip from Ho Chi Minh City

route_note: Buses from the An Suong or Mien Tay area run to Tay Ninh in about 2-2.5 hours; from town a short taxi or local bus reaches the Cao Dai temple and Ba Den Mountain cable car.
see: Cao Dai Holy See temple and noon ceremony
tour_query: Cao Dai temple and Ba Den Mountain day trip from Ho Chi Minh City
